concept.hr: Discover, offer, request, ack; obnavljanje na T1 i T2; istek dodjele
concept.en: Discover, offer, request, ack; renewal at T1 and T2; expiry

summary.hr: Klijent bez adrese dobiva je u četiri poruke, obnavlja je na pola vremena, a kad poslužitelj nestane, gubi je na isteku.
summary.en: A client without an address gets one in four messages, renews it at half time, and loses it at expiry when the server is gone.
